hero.description: I’m a beginner front-end developer. I enjoy building simple, clean interfaces while learning new tools and techniques along the way. Every project is an opportunity for me to grow, improve, and take another step forward in my journey as a developer.

about.subtitle: Beginner Front-End Developer
about.paragraph_1: Hi, I’m Sergiu, a front-end developer at the start of my journey. I’m passionate about turning ideas into simple, clean, and functional web experiences. Right now, I’m focused on learning the fundamentals of modern web development while experimenting with design and code to build real-world projects.
about.paragraph_2: As a student at ULIM, I enjoy combining what I learn in class with hands-on practice. I’m always looking for opportunities to improve, explore new tools, and take on projects that challenge me to grow both as a developer and as a designer.

web_dev.title: Web Development
web_dev.description: I’m learning to build responsive, accessible, and modern websites using technologies like HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and React.

ui_ux.title: UI/UX Design
ui_ux.description: I enjoy designing clean, user-friendly interfaces and focusing on the details that make a smooth and enjoyable user experience.

project_growth.title: Project Growth
project_growth.description: Every project I work on helps me develop new skills, understand best practices, and become more confident as a developer ready to take on bigger challenges.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.placeholder_text: Here are some of the projects I’ve created.

burger_craft.title: Burger Craft
burger_craft.description: A web application for building and ordering custom burgers. Using zustand for state management.

weather_app.title: Weather app
weather_app.description: A weather forecasting app with an interactive map. Using OpenWeatherMap API.

product-dashboard.title: Product Dashboard
product-dashboard.description: A product management dashboard with authentication. Using RESTful API and Axios to fetch data.

coll-doc-editor.title: Col Docs Editor
coll-doc-editor.description: A Google Docs–style collaborative editor with real-time multi-user editing and live cursors. Using Yjs CRDTs over WebSockets and Supabase.

contact.title: Get In Touch
contact.description: I’m ready to take on new opportunities and contribute to projects. I’d be happy to connect and collaborate on anything where I can learn and grow.
